fees.notes: International (UKMi) tuition per UKMShape fee schedule 2024/2025: RM520,520 total (incl. first-semester registration) for 10 semesters; per_year = total / 5 years (derived). source table is internally inconsistent: tuition column totals RM545,000 + RM2,520 registration while the quoted TOTAL column is RM520,520; the quoted total is used. Source: https://shape.ukm.my/storage/lampiran/struktur_yuran/FGG/pra/strukturyuran_FGG_UKMi_pra_F_int.pdf (accessed 2026-09-18).
